# cut_tree_to_labels { #dyf.cut_tree_to_labels }

```python
cut_tree_to_labels(
    tree,
    n_points,
    n_clusters,
    *,
    max_depth=None,
    embeddings=None,
)
```

Cut a DYF tree into flat cluster labels.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                                                                                | Default    |
|------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| tree       |        | Tree dict from ``build_dyf_tree``.                                                                                         | _required_ |
| n_points   |        | Total number of points.                                                                                                    | _required_ |
| n_clusters |        | Desired number of clusters.                                                                                                | _required_ |
| max_depth  |        | Unused. Accepted so callers written against the two-tree dispatcher keep working; it was only ever required for PCA trees. | `None`     |
| embeddings |        | (n, d) array — required, used for leaf centroids.                                                                          | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                          |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | np.ndarray of shape (n_points,) with cluster labels. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                     |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the tree shape is unrecognized or ``embeddings`` is missing. |
